en-US.title: KBMS
en-US.subtitle: KiloVault HLX+ Battery Monitor
en-US.description:
KBMS is a free, open-source utility designed for owners of KiloVault® HLX+ LiFePO4 batteries. Developed as a modern replacement for the original KiloVault app, KBMS provides a reliable, real-time interface to monitor and configure your energy storage system via Bluetooth.

Key Features:
• Real-Time Monitoring: Track Voltage, Amps, SoC, and Temp.
• Cell Health: Monitor individual cell voltages and balance status.
• Cycle Tracking: View total cycle counts and historical usage.
• Privacy Focused: No ads, no tracking, and no data collection.

KBMS is licensed under the MIT License. View our source code or contribute at: https://github.com/dcoon/kbms
en-US.promoText: Reliably monitor your KiloVault HLX+ LiFePO4 batteries. Real-time voltage, cell balancing, and cycle data in a clean, open-source interface.

review.notes: This app is a specialized utility designed to monitor and configure KiloVault HLX+ LiFePO4 batteries via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Because the app requires physical hardware to function, we have implemented a Demo/Mock Data Mode to allow for a full evaluation of the user interface and data visualization features. In Demo Mode, users can interact with the app as if it were connected to a real battery, with simulated data that mimics the behavior of an actual KiloVault HLX+ battery. The App will automatically enter Demo Mode if it detects that Bluetooth is not available (ie. in a simulator). On a physical device, manually activate demo mode in Settings.
